evidence_note: Every series read here is Observed Data or a Calculated Metric already published by its own domain module. The current reading, historical percentile, band, magnitude and duration are Calculated Metrics / Statistical Signals (L2/L3). 'possible_interpretations' is a fixed, versioned registry of hedged candidate readings, not an AI-generated explanation — nothing here labels an anomaly bullish or bearish, forecasts a price, or gives an automatic trading recommendation.
not_tracked: Whale flows and exchange flows are the SAME underlying measured quantity in this platform (whale-to-exchange on-chain net flow) — not two independently observed feeds.

Institutional treasury purchases only cover BTC (no verified free source publishes dated purchases for other assets — see cfi.institutional.universe.TREASURY_PURCHASE_ASSETS) and only accumulation events; treasury disposals are not tracked.
Liquidations are single-venue (OKX) — not a whole-market liquidation total.
Volume is single-venue (Coinbase) — not a whole-market volume total.
Social activity is a retail-ATTENTION proxy (trending meme-coin count), never a capital-flow measure. Retail activity is a small-output-transaction PROXY, never retail-exclusive data.
Market structure here is TOTAL crypto market capitalization only (Phase 12 gap: no ranged history yet for the Market Structure Score or BTC dominance).
Mid-cap, DeFi-sector, AI-related and meme assets have no tracked anomaly feed (this platform's tracked universe is BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP; whale/exchange flows are BTC/ETH only).
